name: zvideo_fxpass3_update_local
description: zVideo_FxPass3_UpdateLocal forwards the frame delta to the global local FxPass3 config update helper.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zVideo FxPass3 wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo FxPass3 source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bef70 validates forwarding deltaTime to zVideoFxPass3Config_UpdateLocal(&g_zVideo_FxPass3ConfigLocal, ...).
The native FxPass3 smoke verifies the public wrapper updates global-config children and clears the global slotWriteIndex.
